architecture.mechanism: variable side-flap mechanism with a peculiar orientation for introducing three components of forces
architecture.intervention: Integrate active, adjustable side-flap structures into the chassis and lower body of the record-speed car to generate controllable lateral and vertical force vectors during high-speed travel and cornering.
architecture.expected_effect: Enhanced stability and safety through reduced braking effort and managed oversteer via flap-induced vortices, alongside optimized drag and downforce management.
architecture.falsification_test: Conduct wind tunnel or CFD simulations at high Reynolds numbers varying flap angles (10°–90°) to verify that the induced vortex and force components significantly reduce lateral instability metrics without exceeding structural load limits.
